hypothesis: When artifact binding is introduced over persisted older capability state, a TOOL receipt with successful old-generation trials but no exact artifact provenance must not inherit those trials into the first artifact-bound generation.

pre_fix_path.reason: observe_capability_presence preserved previous trial_generation whenever previous_artifact was absent, so a pre-artifact CAN_DELEGATE receipt could carry old trials into the newly artifact-bound presence
pre_fix_path.effect_boundary: persistent candidate upgrade/migration only; no remote exploit claim

repair.policy: non-revoked TOOL state that has a trial_generation but lacks artifact provenance always starts a new trial_generation when exact artifact binding is first established
repair.history: old capability_trials are preserved raw but excluded from current artifact-bound competence

regression_gate.scenario: seed a pre-artifact TOOL belief as CAN_DELEGATE with two legacy-generation successes and no artifact hash; current read must already fail closed; re-observation must bind exact artifact with zero effective trials/new generation; only two newly bound probes may restore CAN_DELEGATE; all four raw trials must remain

peer_route_research.adjudication: DO_NOT_SYNTHESIZE_PEER_CAN_DELEGATE; keep external peer UNKNOWN until a current independent producer creates verifiable route receipts
peer_route_research.design_analogy: reuse V17 producer-owned immutable support receipt / consumer-only validation pattern, while keeping peer capability separate from effect authority
